name: Marzia lost in space
source:
A short linear story about a girl who has gotten herself stuck in space! Will she survive in the end or will it be her end?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一個女孩不小心把自己困在了太空裡。這是一個沒有分支的短篇故事。最後她能活下來，還是會就此走到生命的盡頭？

（來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815210/]Steam[/url]）
